# S04 · Arrays and Lists II — arrangements and rules

[Arrays, lists, loops, conditionals and sine]({{ site.baseurl }}/sessions/#b04) · Target weeks 4–5

Compare hexagonal and radial arrangements, select index ranges and control displacement with sine.

**Class file:** [Arrays and Lists II — arrangements and rules]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/03-arrays-lists/Arrays-Lists-Session-2.blend)

Use these example files only as a reference if you are struggling with a step. Build your own file and follow the process one step at a time. Compare the example to understand where you are stuck, then return to your own work. The supplied examples are not files to submit as your assignment.

Select the lesson object and change parameters on the nodes or, where provided, in the GeometryNodes modifier. Press Home over the node editor. Explanations are in Frames and native node names are retained. Build the exercise in a new file of your own, following each step in order.

## Follow the file

1. Hexagonal array
2. Radial array
3. If and range
4. Sine curve

## Short assignment

Make one hexagonal or radial arrangement, one conditional range change and one sine-controlled variation of the same component.

## Lesson notes and project connection

[Arrays and lists]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/tutorials/u04-arrays-and-lists/) — The next unit replaces an index-based rule with a measurement from an external object.

Develop this exercise in [P2 — Repetition and response — arrays to attractors]({{ site.baseurl }}/modules/assignments/p2-repetition-and-response-arrays-to-attractors/).
